title: Chat widget UI loads correctly
description: Verify that the chat widget loads as a floating bubble and expands to the chat window across multiple browsers and device types.

steps.description: Open supported browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on desktop and mobile devices.
Navigate to a webpage with the embedded CallWaiting AI Chat Widget.
Confirm that the floating bubble chat widget appears on page load.
Click or tap the floating bubble.
Confirm the expandable chat window opens with correct UI layout.
Verify smooth animations of the UI elements and gradient style are applied.

title: Text chat mode: send message and receive AI response
description: Validate that users can type text messages and receive context-aware, AI-generated text responses within 3 seconds latency.

steps.description: Open chat widget and select text chat mode.
Input a valid text message (e.g., 'What are your support hours?').
Send the message.
Verify that a loading indicator appears while waiting for the AI response.
Confirm that an AI-generated text reply appears within 3 seconds.
Ensure the response is professional, concise (~100 words), and context-aware.

title: Voice chat mode: record, send, and receive synthesized speech response
description: Check that voice recording captures audio input, transmits it correctly, and plays an accurate AI-generated female voice response.

steps.description: Open chat widget and select voice chat mode.
Activate microphone and record a voice message of at least 5 seconds.
Stop recording to send the message.
Verify that recording timer displays accurately during voice capture.
Confirm audio is transmitted via HTTP POST to backend n8n workflows.
Check that the AI text response is displayed in the chat window.
Verify that the MiniMax TTS female voice audio plays automatically with clear quality and minimal latency.
Ensure the audio playback functions correctly across browsers without failure or delay.

title: Command-line webhook tester validation
description: Run the automated `node test-webhook.js` tool and verify successful webhook response validation including JSON structure with 'text' and 'audio_url' fields.

steps.description: Execute `node test-webhook.js` from command line in the project root.
Confirm the webhook returns a JSON response containing 'text' and 'audio_url' keys.
Check that the 'text' value contains a valid AI response string.
Verify that the 'audio_url' value is a valid URL pointing to an audio file.
Ensure the test output reports a pass status with no errors.

title: Security protocols enforcement
description: Verify that security measures including API key protection, CORS restrictions, HTTPS enforcement, input validation, and rate limiting are correctly implemented and effective.

steps.description: Attempt to call API endpoints without a valid API key.
Confirm that the requests are rejected with appropriate error codes (e.g., 401 Unauthorized).
Send requests with malformed or malicious input data.
Verify input validation rejects the bad inputs gracefully without server errors.
Make API requests from unauthorized origins to test CORS policies.
Confirm that CORS restrictions block unauthorized clients.
Attempt HTTP connections instead of HTTPS.
Verify HTTP requests are redirected or blocked enforcing HTTPS.
Send a high volume of requests to test rate limiting middleware.
Ensure the system throttles requests beyond limits returning 429 Too Many Requests.

title: Session management and authentication flow
description: Validate user authentication processes including login, signup, password reset, and session persistence via Supabase.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page and create a new user with valid credentials.
Confirm account creation is successful and user is redirected to dashboard.
Logout and then attempt login with the new credentials.
Verify login is successful and session is established.
Open forgot-password page and submit valid email for reset.
Check that password reset instruction is sent.
Use reset-password link to set a new password.
Verify that new password works and user can log in.
Close and reopen browser; verify session persistence.
Confirm user remains logged in without needing to re-authenticate immediately.

title: AI response context awareness and professionalism
description: Ensure AI-generated responses are context-aware, maintain a professional receptionist tone, and concise with approximately 100 words per reply.

steps.description: Send multiple related questions in text and voice chat modes.
Verify responses maintain conversation context and build upon prior messages.
Ensure that the tone of replies is professional and matches receptionist style.
Confirm each response is concise, roughly around 100 words.

title: Audio playback compatibility and performance
description: Test that audio playback of AI TTS responses works smoothly across supported browsers without delays or failures.

steps.description: Trigger voice chat TTS response on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers.
Verify that the audio automatically plays upon receiving AI reply.
Confirm audio playback is clear, without stuttering or glitches.
Check that audio controls, if any, respond correctly and user can pause or replay audio.

title: Error handling during voice recording and transmission
description: Test behavior when microphone access is denied, recording fails, or network issues occur during voice chat.

steps.description: Deny microphone permission in the browser and activate voice recording.
Confirm a user-friendly error message is displayed regarding microphone access.
Simulate network failure or timeout when sending recorded audio.
Verify the system displays an appropriate error and allows retry.
Attempt to record extremely short (<1 second) audio clips.
Ensure the system rejects too short recordings with guidance to record longer input.

title: Multiple n8n workflow configurations validation
description: Verify that importing and activating n8n workflow configurations enable AI + TTS integration and production readiness as per documentation.

steps.description: Import provided n8n workflows for quick setup, AI + TTS integration, and production.
Confirm workflows are activated without errors in n8n interface.
Test chat widget sends requests to configured workflows and receives proper AI and TTS responses.
Verify documentation instructions for workflow import and testing match actual steps.

title: Documentation completeness and clarity
description: Ensure that included documentation provides clear, detailed step-by-step guidance for setup, testing tools, troubleshooting, and production deployment.

steps.description: Review documentation covering installation, n8n workflows setup, webhook testing, and deployment processes.
Confirm all setup steps are clearly described, with required commands, environment variable setups, and expected outcomes.
Verify troubleshooting section covers common issues with solutions.
Confirm documentation for testing tools (CLI webhook tester, browser debug) are detailed and accurate.

title: Production deployment stability and monitoring
description: Validate that production deployment runs without critical errors, with enabled rate limiting, proper logging, and stable operation under normal load.

steps.description: Deploy the solution to production environment following documented procedures.
Monitor logs from client and server sides for errors during normal usage scenario.
Simulate normal usage patterns including multiple users interacting with text and voice chat.
Confirm no critical errors or unhandled exceptions are logged.
Verify rate limiting is active and correctly regulates excessive request patterns without disrupting normal users.

title: Rate limiting enforcement on high request volume
description: Ensure the middleware throttles API requests exceeding configured rate limits, returning HTTP 429 responses.

steps.description: Send a burst of valid API requests exceeding the configured request threshold within a short time frame.
Verify the server responds to excess requests with 429 Too Many Requests status.
Confirm that normal requests below threshold continue to be served correctly.

title: Input validation for chat widget text input
description: Test text input validation in chat widget to prevent injection, invalid characters, or oversized messages.

steps.description: Enter various invalid text inputs including scripts, special characters, and messages exceeding maximum length.
Verify the input is sanitized or rejected with friendly error messages.
Enter valid text inputs including edge cases like whitespace only and multi-language characters.
Confirm these inputs are accepted and properly processed.
